finish.summary: A 7-cell hex station: covered flat deck staging a cinewhoop and spare props, a divided bin holding LiPo packs, capped open faces and bolted joints (check_build: meshClash clear, one minor uncapped face at 2,1,0 noted). The filament side is built as a rod-socket bay plus spool axle across the centre cell, but the configurator refused to hang the filament spool there (it overlaps the neighbouring wall), so filament holding is structural-only and marked partial. Drones likewise partial: cinewhoop and batteries staged, the 5-inch quad not verified to fit the deck.
